facts.claim: John J. Galiher serves as Chief Executive Officer.
Preferred Freezer Services was acquired by Lineage Logistics in February 2019.
facts.source_snippet: Joining Lineage will bring Preferred to the next level of customer service ... since founding Preferred Freezer Services in 1989. ... Lineage Logistics Announces Acquisition of Preferred Freezer Services

facts.claim: After the acquisition, the combined entity has over 1.3 billion cubic feet of temperature‑controlled capacity across more than 200 facilities worldwide.
facts.source_snippet: Following the closing, the combined company will feature over 1.3 billion cubic feet of temperature-controlled capacity across over 200 facilities, with a global footprint spanning North America, Europe and Asia.

facts.claim: The acquisition was backed by Bay Grove, the principal investment firm supporting Lineage Logistics.
facts.source_snippet: We have followed Preferred’s impressive growth and innovations under John’s leadership ... bringing these two companies together would reinforce our vision ..." commented Kevin Marchetti, Co‑Founder and Managing Partner of Bay Grove, the principal investment firm backing Lineage.

facts.claim: Preferred Freezer Services is now a private subsidiary of Lineage Logistics Holdings, LLC.
facts.source_snippet: Preferred Freezer Services CEO: John J. Galiher ... PrivateSubsidiary of Lineage Logistics Holdings, LLC

facts.claim: Post‑merger, the combined company operates 17 automated facilities with more than 800,000 automated pallet positions.
facts.source_snippet: After the merger, Lineage will have 17 automated facilities with more than 800,000 automated pallet positions.
